messages:
Rachel: Quick async recap from the weekly OKR check — sharing what actually shipped vs slipped and immediate next steps. tagging owners: @Kevin, @Sara, @Nora.

Kevin: Thanks — quick bullets please, keeping it tight.

Rachel: Shipped:
- Model routing alpha: deployed to canary (10% traffic) yesterday. :tada: Kevin owns follow-up canary metrics.
- SDK docs for rollout APIs: published in docs site. Sara did the edits.

Sara: Confirming SDK docs update — added examples for pinning model versions and fallback policy. Link: https://internal.docs/redwood/sdk-rollout

Nora: Slipped:
- Batching reliability fixes (GC/kv-cache race) — regressed under long-tail sequences. Blocker: root cause under investigation.
- Canary autoscale policy tuning — still needs load tests.

Kevin: For batching: reproducer script works locally. Opening PR with fix, but tests flake on 128-token sequences. Pinging eng-sre to reproduce on staging.

Nora: Eng-sre looped in. Will run the script across the 3 hardware profiles this afternoon and report.

Rachel: Ownership clarifications:
- Model routing canary -> Kevin (eng-runtime)
- SDK/Docs -> Sara (devex)
- Batching fixes -> Kevin + Nora (eng-runtime + eng-sre)
- Autoscale tuning -> Nora (eng-sre) with product support from me

Sara: Quick ask: once routing canary hits 24h with no errors, we'll schedule a short demo for customer-facing teams. Can you add a line item to the canary runbook for demo cutoff?

Kevin: Will add to runbook. Also adding one-line acceptance criteria: tail latency P95 < 120ms and 0.5% or lower HTTP 5xxs for 24h.

Rachel: Next steps (by Friday EOD):
- Kevin: PR for batching fix + link to flaky test (in review).
- Nora: Run reproducer on staging across hw profiles and post results.
- Sara: Draft customer demo slide + add runbook demo cutoff.
- Rachel: Prepare rollback plan and update OKR tracker.

Kevin: CR ping: @Sara @Nora I put the batching fix PR up: https://git.redwood/infra/PR-4823 — small change but test sensitive. Can you review?

Sara: On it, will take a look by EOD.

Nora: I can smoke test the PR on staging after merge.

DevOps Bot: Deploy started for routing-canary v0.1 -> canary pool (10%). Build: 2026.03.12-1891

Rachel: Status updates back here please. If anything looks like it will slip into next week, call it out and we'll reassign trade-offs. :eyes:

Kevin: Noted. I expect batching PR merge today if tests behave.

Sara: Demo slide queued. Will share draft link in this thread.

Nora: Staging runs underway — posting results in ~2 hours.

Rachel: Thanks team — short nails: ship routing canary, land batching fix, verify autoscale tuning. We'll sync in next week's async OKR thread for final closure. :rocket:
